sessions_one_subject.name: sessions_one_subject
sessions_one_subject.value: (user_id IS NOT NULL AND donor_id IS NULL) OR (user_id IS NULL AND donor_id IS NOT NULL)

donors_tax_id_type_required.name: donors_tax_id_type_required
donors_tax_id_type_required.value: tax_id_number IS NULL OR tax_id_type IS NOT NULL

volunteers_hours_non_negative.name: volunteers_hours_non_negative
volunteers_hours_non_negative.value: total_hours >= 0 AND verified_hours >= 0 AND verified_hours <= total_hours

volunteers_id_requires_approval.name: volunteers_id_requires_approval
volunteers_id_requires_approval.value: (volunteer_id IS NULL AND status IN ('applied','under_review','rejected')) OR (volunteer_id IS NOT NULL AND status NOT IN ('applied','under_review','rejected'))

campaigns_dates_ordered.name: campaigns_dates_ordered
campaigns_dates_ordered.value: end_date IS NULL OR start_date IS NULL OR end_date > start_date

success_stories_consent_before_publish.name: success_stories_consent_before_publish
success_stories_consent_before_publish.value: status <> 'published' OR subject_name IS NULL OR is_anonymised = true OR consent_obtained = true

impact_updates_has_parent.name: impact_updates_has_parent
impact_updates_has_parent.value: campaign_id IS NOT NULL OR program_id IS NOT NULL

events_dates_ordered.name: events_dates_ordered
events_dates_ordered.value: end_date IS NULL OR end_date >= start_date

donation_items_type_consistent.name: donation_items_type_consistent
donation_items_type_consistent.value: (item_type = 'product' AND campaign_product_id IS NOT NULL) OR (item_type = 'custom' AND campaign_product_id IS NULL)

refunds_separation_of_duties.name: refunds_separation_of_duties
refunds_separation_of_duties.value: approved_by IS NULL OR initiated_by IS NULL OR approved_by <> initiated_by
